Completed batch 10 in the physics workspace. All three selected sources were fetched and stamped: [BSc Optics §6.3](https://phys.libretexts.org/Bookshelves/Optics/BSc_Optics_%28Konijnenberg_Adam_and_Urbach%29/06%3A_Scalar_diffraction_optics/6.04%3A_Angular_Spectrum_Method), [Beisert’s ETH notes](https://people.phys.ethz.ch/~nbeisert/lectures/ED-24FS-Skript.pdf), and [Cerjan & Cerjan’s paper](https://alexcerjan.com/documents/papers/cerjan_JOSA_2011.pdf).
